hook: Jian Sun was born in Xi'an, China, in 1977 and earned his bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees, all from Xi'an Jiaotong University, completing his PhD in 2003. He then spent thirteen years at Microsoft Research Asia working on computer vision and computer graphics, contributing to technologies including Windows Hello facial recognition, Kinect Identity, and the Computer Vision and Face APIs for Microsoft Azure. In 2015, with Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang and Shaoqing Ren, he co-authored Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition, which introduced residual connections that let neural networks be trained far deeper than before by having layers learn a difference from their input rather than a full transformation. The resulting ResNet architecture won the ImageNet and COCO competitions in 2015 and became one of the most widely used building blocks in computer vision. In July 2016 he joined Megvii, the Beijing based computer vision company behind Face++, as Chief Scientist and Managing Director of Research, and from January 2019 he also served as Dean of the College of Artificial Intelligence at Xi'an Jiaotong University. He died on June 14, 2022.

achievements.title: Co-invented the ResNet architecture
achievements.impact: Residual connections solved the degradation problem that had limited how deep neural networks could be trained, enabling networks with over 100 layers and setting a new standard for image recognition accuracy.

achievements.title: Built vision technology used across Microsoft products
achievements.impact: His work at Microsoft Research Asia contributed to Kinect Identity, Windows Hello and Azure's Computer Vision and Face APIs, bringing research into shipped consumer and enterprise products.

achievements.title: Led research at Megvii as Chief Scientist
achievements.impact: Directed research behind Megvii's face recognition and computer vision products, including repeated wins in the COCO and Mapillary vision challenges between 2015 and 2019.

achievements.title: Received the National Natural Science Award of China
achievements.impact: Awarded China's Second Class National Natural Science Award in 2016 for contributions to computer vision research.
